dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, how did you meet the owner?

dialogues.speaker: Okazaki Erika
dialogues.text: You're asking about us? Well, that's a tough question. It's a long story with a side of karma, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Okazaki Erika
dialogues.text: When I was still young, I was ordered to monitor an important figure at the Tenryou Commission. Somehow...

dialogues.speaker: Okazaki Erika
dialogues.text: *sigh* Forget it. I can only thank the archons that this person eventually retired, and we could finally get married after that. Thank the archons, indeed!
